notes: Product-kernel money-free observation vertical from repository substrate: public Yahoo chart parse → typed PriceBar. Honest O1 ON_DEMAND. Not a watch/poll/push bus. Distinct from the NewsApp evaluator fixture, which proves O2/O4 semantics without a live provider. Does not move money.

semantic_contract.user_intent: On demand, fetch public OHLCV and normalize into typed price bars with provider timestamps.
semantic_contract.preconditions: Outbound HTTP allowed; no API key; no account.
semantic_contract.state_transition: provider JSON → typed PriceBar list (request-local unless a later store exists)
semantic_contract.output: PriceBar { as_of_unix, open, high, low, close, adj_close, volume }
semantic_contract.persistence_requirement: request-local parse; no durable watch store
semantic_contract.authority_requirement: public feed parse is unauthenticated; a later store must be company-scoped
semantic_contract.tenant_requirement: public parse kernel is not tenant-gated; a later store must be company-scoped
semantic_contract.visibility_access_semantics: public market data; not a paid entitlement corpus
semantic_contract.failure_semantics: provider error, empty result, mismatched OHLCV lengths fail closed
semantic_contract.idempotency_semantics: parse is a pure function of the response body
semantic_contract.concurrency_semantics: not applicable to a pure parse
semantic_contract.user_observable_outcome: typed bars available to callers; no order, position, or spend
semantic_contract.no_ai_behavior: deterministic JSON parse; AI not required
semantic_contract.chronica_allowed_divergences: Chronica adapter is parse/normalize only; no watch bus, no broker execution
semantic_contract.known_unimplemented_facets: durable observation subscription, shipped MarketDataApp caller, O2+ poll/push
